chunks: Tell those who dispute this with you even after the knowledge that has reached you: "Come, let us gather our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, and pray and solicit God to condemn those who lie."
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Mubahala in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'anfusana' (our selves) is specifically interpreted as referring to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, while 'abna'una' (our sons) denotes Hasan and Husayn, establishing the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate proof of truth. This event serves as a definitive validation of their divine appointment and purity, reinforcing the concept of Imamah within the broader narrative of prophetic authority.
